procedure.method: Independent fresh-session critique using only the user-listed pinned inputs. Read the packet, literal case, review rules, rubric and compact method; verified hashes/byte counts and PNG header dimensions, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded unlisted paths. The packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so no source opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. Actually opened and visually inspected exact M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320, then M2 native/use/thumbnail, M3 native/use/thumbnail, M4 native/use/thumbnail, and M5 native/use/thumbnail with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), returned as images through functions.exec. All fifteen successful ordered visual opens preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage and every judgment/score. Only afterward retained first actual raw readings in packet order in session memory; made one ambiguity-triggered exact M5 native revisit covering three separator entries. No image generation/edit, substitute/crop, peer/producer/planner record inspection, OCR inference, spawn/fork/resume, or invented runtime ID/tool event was used. Native ratio judgments use exact packet dimensions and the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge rule. Scores are this critic's judgments, with unresolved punctuation kept NA.

덕테이프 포스터로 성인 주민을 위한 동네 저녁 음식·음악 행사를 안내해줘. 제철 음식을 즐기며 동네 음악을 듣고 이웃과 편하게 머무르는 하나의 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 일정·장소·입장·참여·방문 안내를 읽을 수 있어야 하고 실제 업체나 음악가의 홍보물처럼 보이지 않게 해줘. 단색·거의 단색·분할 색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 안내 블록에 작은 사진을 붙인 템플릿은 제외해줘. 제목과 안내만 담으려고 빈 벽·바닥·실내 장면을 배경으로 만들거나 글꼴·질감만 바꿔 같은 정보 판형을 유지하지 말아줘. 이미지 표현·편집·크롭·공간·글자·정보의 관계까지 서로 다른 다섯 방향이어야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction, not type/whitespace-only,tiny texture/icon or glyph-model loophole.

evidence.location: left musician, center residents, foreground serving bowl
evidence.observation: Large nonglyph figures, playing flute, holding cups and eating beside a shared seasonal-green dish occupy most of the image and communicate the actual event.

evidence.location: foreground bowl and midground audience
evidence.observation: The close food crop leads into neighbors oriented toward the musician; the visual relationships remain substantial at screen size, beyond ornaments or texture.

content_form.observation: Seasonal greens, adults with cups and a visibly playing flutist connect food, lingering and local music within one illuminated courtyard.

hierarchy.location: upper middle title and upper-right details
hierarchy.observation: The brush title anchors the scene, the date is above it and location/entry form a second clear group; foreground food is a strong competing image focal point but does not erase the announcement.
The headline survives the dense foliage and crowd reduction.

typography.observation: Expressive Korean brush forms contrast with clean, consistently dark sans details; all words and the dash are legible.

typography.location: upper-right admission/participation and lower-right cup instruction
typography.observation: Small practical lines retain readable glyphs, although these are the least robust sizes in the composition.

space.location: foreground bowl crop and title wall
space.observation: Full-bleed bowl, left musician and right listeners create deliberate depth and occupied margins; text uses two clear pale openings rather than covering faces or food.

image_material.location: bowls, ladle, hands, clothing and lantern-lit foliage
image_material.observation: Food, glazed ceramics and human gestures are locally legible within a consistent painterly scene; foreground detail is denser than the faces but remains visually integrated.

emotion_control.observation: Warm light, relaxed postures and shared cups convey an approachable adult evening with a specific sense of staying together.

ai_slop.location: musician, serving bowl and right-hand cup/bowl gestures
ai_slop.observation: The scene has interpretable actions and no prominent contradictory body or vessel construction, added lettering or brand marks; dense foliage and repeated floral garnish remain a polish limit.

residuals: The two admission/participation lines at upper right and the cup prompt have little readability reserve at usage720.
Highly detailed foreground soup and numerous lantern/foliage accents compete with the practical announcement.

hierarchy.location: upper-right title versus lower-left date/time band
hierarchy.observation: Two large, diagonally opposed type anchors pull in separate directions while the food and guitar each supply another focal point; the event is readable but its practical reading sequence is fragmented.

hierarchy.observation: Supporting information is spread across four distant positions rather than gathered into a clearly ranked participation path.

typography.location: dark title/date panels and white on-image text
typography.observation: Bold Korean and English retain clear counters, word spaces and strong contrast; date and time are unusually prominent but cleanly set.

space.location: diagonal seams and bottom guitar crop
space.observation: The panels use the horizontal frame fully, with decisive food and instrument crops and practical lines kept away from the visible faces.

image_material.location: food spatula/plate transfer, faces, guitar and hands
image_material.observation: The photographic actions are locally credible and the warm color treatment joins the panels; hard seams are deliberate editorial cuts rather than unresolved blank-plane dressing.

emotion_control.observation: The food-service detail and relaxed table conversation communicate a sociable, approachable evening, with guitar supplying a quieter musical cue.

ai_slop.observation: Food transfer and guitar-playing hands are coherent at inspection scale, with no prominent extra copy, pseudo-brand or arbitrary miniature motif; the assembled three-panel event still has a generic promotional-montage quality.

residuals: Hierarchy remains below the professional-resolution floor: the equally forceful title/date corners and scattered instructions do not establish a single settled reading route.
Hard photo seams unite themes graphically but do not show a shared continuous physical space.
